verses.1: Then Solomon said, “YHWH has said to Shekhan in Arfel.”
verses.2: And I have built a house for you to dwell in, and a place for your feet to rest on forever.
verses.3: And the king turned his face away and blessed all the people of Israel.
verses.4: And the Lord God of Israel said, “Blessed be You, O God of Israel, who has spoken through His mouth about David, my father, and who has fulfilled His words.”
verses.5: From the day I led my people out of Egypt, I did not choose any city among all the cities of Israel to build my house in. Nor did I choose any man to be judge over my people Israel.
verses.6: And I will choose Jerusalem as my place of residence. And I will choose David to be the leader of my people, Israel.
verses.7: And David, my father, built houses for the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.8: And the LORD said to David, my father: “Because he was with you in building my house, let them be blessed, for he was with you.”
verses.9: Only you will not build the house. It will be built for me, because he who came from your rescue will build the house for me.
verses.10: And Jehovah made his word come true. He will stand under David, my father, and reign over Israel, just as Jehovah had said. I will build a house for Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.11: And I will set up there the Ark of the Covenant, which contains the covenant that Yahweh made with the children of Israel.
verses.12: And he stood before the altar of Yahweh, facing all the people of Israel. He spread out his hands.
verses.13: For Solomon made it into a lampstand. He set it within the Temple. It had five cubits in length, and five cubits in width. Its height was six cubits. He stood on it, and blessed over all the people of Israel. Then he spread out his hands toward heaven.
verses.14: And the LORD, the God of Israel, said: “There is no other god in heaven or on earth who can keep the covenant and show mercy to those who serve you, and who walk before you with all their hearts.”
verses.15: You have obeyed David, my father, in doing what you said to him. You spoke through your mouth and with your hands, just as you did on this day.
verses.16: And now, LORD, God of Israel, protect David, my father, from those who say that no man shall sit on the throne of Israel before they follow my laws and regulations just as you did before.
verses.17: And now, Jehovah, God of Israel, I swear by your word, which you have spoken to your servant David.
verses.18: For surely, God will dwell with man on the earth. Now, even though the heavens and the skies cannot hold you, yet this house that I have built will still be able to contain you.
verses.19: And I turned my face towards your worship and towards his worship, O LORD God, so that He might hear those prayers that your servant offers before you.
verses.20: May your eyes be open, day and night, to this house. To the place where you said, “Your name shall be there.” To the place where your servant will pray.
verses.21: And you heard from your servants and from the people of Israel, who are your followers, that they have gone to this place. And you heard from your place in heaven as well. So you forgave them.
verses.22: If a man sins against his neighbor, and another person takes up that sin and brings it before your altar in this house.
verses.23: And you shall hear from heaven, and then you will judge your servants, so that the wicked may be turned away from their ways, and the righteous may receive their due reward.
verses.24: And if your people, Israel, are besieged by their enemies, because they have sinned against you, then they should return and worship your name. They should pray to you in this house.
verses.25: And you will hear from heaven and forgive the sins of your people, Israel. You will bring them back to the land that you gave them and to their ancestors.
verses.26: When the heavens are closed, and there is no light, then they will sin against you. They will pray to this place, and worship your name. But they will return, for you will answer them.
verses.27: And you shall hear from heaven and forgive the sins of your servants and your people, Israel. For you have chosen the right path for them to follow. And you have given them a land that you gave to your people as an inheritance.
verses.28: There will be hunger in the land; there will be suffering and pain. There will be destruction and devastation when his enemies take control of the land. Every touch and every illness will be caused by them.
verses.29: Every prayer, every offering that is made for all people and for all of your people, Israel, so that they may understand the pain and suffering of others, and so that they may bow their heads in worship before this house.
verses.30: And you will hear from heaven the sound of your rest and forgiveness. You will give to man all his ways, knowing that it is only you who truly know the hearts of human beings.
verses.31: So that you may fear to go in your ways, all the days that they still live on this earth that You have given to our ancestors.
verses.32: And also to the foreigner who is not from your people, Israel. He came from a distant land, so that your great name and your powerful hand might be glorified. They came and prayed to this house.
verses.33: And you will hear from heaven the words that your Creator has spoken to you. You shall do everything that the foreigner who calls upon you has commanded you. Then all nations of the earth will know your name, and they will see you as the people of Israel. They will understand that your name is given to this house I have built.
verses.34: For your people will go out to war against their enemies along the path you have chosen for them. They will pray to you through this city that you have chosen, and through the house that I have built for your name.
verses.35: And you heard from heaven their prayers and their supplications, and you made their judgments.
verses.36: For they will sin against you, because no one can be without sinning. You will put them before the enemy, and they will return to a distant or nearby land.
verses.37: And they returned to their hearts in the land where they had been banished. They came back and prayed to You in the land of Shibya, saying, “We have sinned, we have wronged ourselves, and we are evil people.”
verses.38: And they returned to you with all their hearts and souls, in the land of Shittim. They returned through the land that You gave to their ancestors. And they also returned to the city that You chose, and to the temple that I built for Your name.
verses.39: And you heard from heaven the sound of their prayers and their supplications. You judged them fairly and forgave your people who had sinned against you.
verses.40: Now, O Lord, may your eyes be open, and your ears attentive to the prayers of this place.
verses.41: And now, LORD God has risen for our salvation. You and your priests, LORD God, shall bring peace and joy to those who are righteous.
verses.42: May the LORD God not turn away from your Messiah. May He remember David’s kindness towards you, His servant.
